checks.message: Professional submission content is complete for readiness review; package promotion remains a separately authorized action.

Exactly three MVPs; unique mapping is MVP-01→S04, MVP-02→S02, MVP-03→S03; constraints and life-safety exclusions are explicit.
S12 is a shared civic governance layer, not an MVP or scenario; only RETIRE proceeds to revoke, deletion verification and physical recovery.
Nine authoritative public Reality Map records are registered; _design_memory is excluded from formal evidence.
Five concrete personas plus an optional evaluator are explicitly design-testing constructs, not demographic claims.
All six unregistered international case names were removed from formal proposal and visuals.
Role-based model only; real institutions require formal agreement.
Conceptual land-use polygons partition the provisional site without material gaps or overlaps.
A3 booklet (8 pages) and A0 boards (5 pages) were rendered through Poppler and inspected page by page; no clipping, overlap, missing glyph or broken-image defect remains.
